public_main_window: Compact Filament and Output pages leave more room for the preview.
The mixed palette and calibration chart use the same read-only F-pair family-major display order while canonical state IDs remain stable.
PLA is the default material; ABS and PETG are opt-in beta modes and never mix material families within one four-filament job.
Automatic proposals use a material-specific, gamut-balanced set of real catalog products.
The public model picker accepts vertex-coloured OBJ and static GLB; embedded baseColor texture is baked to the existing vertex-colour pipeline.
The public Filament Settings page does not expose the legacy reset-all-four-base-colours action.
After an optional F1-F4 edit, Apply Current F1-F4 to Preview / 3MF explicitly rebuilds the converted preview while automatic proposal remains the default workflow.
public_safety: Black-Free Gradient, ColorDepth, Radial, Decal beta, black-inner-wall, split, joint, Help Center, safe-seam-only, manual-joint reprocess, and reset-all-four-base-colours entry points are not exposed in the public UI.
Loading old projects or preferences sanitizes hidden experimental flags to safe defaults.
Physical black correction is the only retained public black-output adjustment.
manual_editing: All drawing tools, colour selection, brush diameter, and fill actions are collected in the Brush panel.
Pending screen-space Airbrush feedback is suppressed immediately after zoom, pan, orbit, or a programmatic camera change while the accepted commit token and Undo transaction remain alive.
Manual-paint batches use local effective-state lookup and compatible layered Airbrush batches traverse the adaptive tree once, with a proven sequential fallback.
The optimized path preserves encoded output, changed roots, overrides, adaptive trees, and Undo/Redo semantics.
Decal beta implementation and tests remain in source, but no ribbon tab, button, menu, image-open callback, or shortcut exposes it in the public Manual Editing UI.
Older projects still load; decal colours baked by an earlier build remain ordinary manual-paint data.
output: Explicit Solidify supports a single GLB without Tripo part markers when its apparent openings prove to be exact 1:1 reversed boundary pairs at coincident UV or texture seams.
The single GLB seam weld runs before cleanup and QEM so face-count reduction cannot destroy the exact seam proof.
The seam path preserves every ordered triangle and part ID and does not add caps; ambiguous seams, non-manifold results, or true holes fail closed without replacing the current geometry.
When export finds an eligible unsolidified model, ChromaMatter announces the safe solidification step, runs it, and resumes export only after success.
Manual paint state and adaptive trees keep exact ordered-face carry across the seam-only vertex remap.
Strict 3MF topology validation checks all type=model resources, including printable child objects that are not direct build items.
A bounded minor self-intersection introduced by QEM is a warning only after all mandatory solid checks pass, and the export guide requires Snapmaker Orca project-open and slice-preview confirmation.
Combined and per-part 3MF output retain physical F1-F4 and stable canonical palette-state semantics.

Export records a stable Full Spectrum layer-cycle and prime-tower baseline while keeping experimental Local Z, advanced dithering, and pointillism disabled and leaving support selection to Snapmaker Orca.
